title: Author verification oracle for hunt->triage findings wiring
acceptance_criteria: Authors a new test file tests/ngv2/test_p11_hunt_triage_findings.py with module and in-test docstrings using triple-double-quotes.
Imports the module under test via normal import.
Drives the real run_conductor_step, gate_executor.run_gates, and transition_planner.plan_next_action without stubs or monkeypatching.
Simulates hunt worker output by feeding persist() realistic harvested artifacts containing a unique sentinel token.
Asserts findings is derived from prior_findings (not pre-injected) and contains the sentinel token, and run_gates('hunt', 'triage', ev) advances.
Asserts run_conductor_step at phase hunt advances to triage and does not block.
Asserts FSM advances past hunt to at least triage in a bounded loop composing with middle phase artifacts.

spec.objective: Author a new test file tests/ngv2/test_p11_hunt_triage_findings.py that verifies the hunt->triage transition is correctly gated by evidence['findings'] derived from state['prior_findings'].
functional_requirements: Verify build_evidence derives findings key from state['prior_findings'] containing a unique sentinel token.
Verify run_gates('hunt', 'triage', ev) advances when findings evidence is present.
Verify run_conductor_step advances session phase from hunt to triage.
Verify end-to-end traversal of FSM from phase hunt progresses past hunt to at least triage when composed with other phase rollups.
edge_cases: State contains empty prior_findings, asserting that findings key is omitted.
Sentinel token is present in the derived findings, proving it was not a pre-injected literal.
non_goals: Integration tests using real workers, live environment, clock, subprocess, network, or sleeps are out of scope (integration is out of scope).
spec.implementation_notes: Implement tests driving the real conductor, using FakeDB to hold state, and feeding realistic hunt report rollups with unique sentinel tokens. Verify correct derivation of findings key and successful transition.

test_spec.test_data_requirements: Hunt report rollup artifacts containing a contracts.Finding shaped dictionary with a unique sentinel token.

token_budget_ratio.note: Task only authors tests, so implementation tokens are zero and test tokens cover the authored tests.

_debug_stamping_reason: Task was only proposed by Gemini.
